description.en: The validity period of the short URL, in days. The maximum value is 90.

description.en: The name of the short URL. Maximum length: 13 characters.

descriptions.zh:
><notice>短信服务暂时不支持使用此接口。></notice>

- 一个自然日最多可以创建3000个短链。
- 短链接生成后，需要进行安全审核，审核时长一般为10分钟~2小时，安全审核通过之前，短链接无法直接访问。
descriptions.en:
><notice>

Short Message Service does not currently support this API operation.

></notice>

- You can create up to 3,000 short URLs per calendar day.

- After a short URL is generated, it must pass a security review, which typically takes 10 minutes to 2 hours. You cannot access the short URL until it passes this review.
